name: EXM_EXPENSE_AUDIT_TRAILS
description: This table contains a snapshot of the expense information for individual expenses within an expense report, when the report is rejected or short paid.

columns.name: AUDIT_TRAIL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the audit trail.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person who owns the expense.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the assignment for the person who owns the expense.

columns.name: AUDIT_TRAIL_EVENT_CODE
columns.description:
Code identifying events in an audit trail
                        AUDITOR_REJECTED : Auditor rejects the expense report.
                        AUDITOR_RMI : Auditor requests more information on the expense report.
                        AUDITOR_SHORT_PAY : Auditor short pays the expense report.
                        APPROVER_REJECTED : Approver rejects the expense report.
                        APPROVER_RMI : Approver requests more information on the expense report.

columns.name: EXPENSE_DATA_JSON
columns.description: A snapshot of the expense information along with the associated itemization and attendee details, captured in JSON format.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.
